title_en: Do you know where … ? / I don’t know what … etc.
title_vi: Do you know where … ? / I don’t know what … v.v. (câu hỏi gián tiếp)
theory_html:
A. Do you know where Paula is?

A. Do you know where Paula is? (bạn có biết Paula ở đâu không?)

We say: Where is Paula? but Do you know where Paula is? (not Do you know where is Paula?)

Ta nói: Where is Paula? nhưng Do you know where Paula is? (không nói Do you know where is Paula?)

In the same way we say: I know / I don’t know / Can you tell me where Paula is.

Tương tự: I know / I don’t know / Can you tell me where Paula is.

question
câu hỏi		Do you know / Can you tell me … ? / I know / I don’t know / I don’t remember …
Who are those people?who those people are
How old is Nicola?how old Nicola is
What time is it?what time it is
Where can I go?where I can go
How much is this camera?how much this camera is
When are you going away?when you’re going away
Where have they gone?where they have gone
What was Kate wearing?what Kate was wearing

B. Questions with do/does/did

B. Câu hỏi có do/does/did

Where does he live? but Do you know where he lives? (not Do you know where does he live?)

Where does he live? nhưng Do you know where he lives? (không nói Do you know where does he live?)

question
câu hỏi		Do you know … ? / I know / I don’t know / I don’t remember …
How do airplanes fly?how airplanes fly
What does Jane want?what Jane wants
Why did she go home?why she went home
Where did I put the key?where I put the key

C. Is … ? / Do … ? / Can … ? (yes/no questions) → if / whether

C. Is … ? / Do … ? / Can … ? (câu hỏi có/không) → if / whether

question
câu hỏi		Do you know if (whether) … ? / I don’t know if (whether) …
Is Jack at home?Jack is at home
Have they got a car?they’ve got a car
Can Ben swim?Ben can swim
Do they live near here?they live near here
Did anybody see you?anybody saw you

You can use if or whether in these sentences:

Có thể dùng if hoặc whether trong các câu này:

  • Do you know if they’ve got a car? or Do you know whether they’ve got a car?

    Bạn có biết liệu họ có xe hơi không?

  • I don’t know if anybody saw me. or I don’t know whether anybody saw me.

    Tôi không biết liệu có ai thấy tôi không.

mcq.question: Do you know where ___?
mcq.full: Do you know where Paula is?
mcq.vi: Bạn có biết Paula ở đâu không?
mcq.expl:
After Do you know / Can you tell me / I don’t know …: question word + subject + verb (where Paula is, not where is Paula).
Sau Do you know / Can you tell me / I don’t know …: từ để hỏi + chủ ngữ + động từ (where Paula is, không nói where is Paula).
Điểm ngữ pháp: Không nói Do you know where is Paula?

Câu hỏi có/không → if / whether + chủ ngữ + động từ (Do you know if they’ve got a car?).
Điểm ngữ pháp: if + he + passed.
mcq.key: (Did he pass his exam?) Do you know if ___ his exam?|he passed

mcq.question: (Is she working today?) Do you know ___ she is working today?

mcq.question: Why ___ going away?
mcq.full: Why are you going away?
mcq.vi: Sao bạn lại đi xa?
mcq.expl:
In a direct question, use normal question word order.
Trong câu hỏi trực tiếp, dùng trật tự câu hỏi bình thường.
Điểm ngữ pháp: Câu hỏi trực tiếp → are you.
mcq.key: Why ___ going away?|are you
